Name: Summon Hydro Ally
Components: VSM (a piece of parchment with a loved one’s name, a loach pearl)
Description:
You call forth an ally from the elemental plane of water. It manifests it in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The ally uses the Hydro Ally stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a Crab, an Octopus, or a Seahorse. The creature resembles a beast of that shape, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn directly after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its move to avoid danger.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell’s level appears in the stat block.

Special Notes.instruction: Render the matching Stat Blocks object as a dedicated Stat Block section after the spell.

Stat Blocks.title: Hydro Ally
Stat Blocks.armor_class: 10 + the level of the spell (natural armor)

speed.walk: 30 ft.; swim 60 ft. (Octopus only); burrow 30 ft. (Crab only); fly 60 ft. (hover) (Seahorse only)

traits.name: Water Form
traits.description: The hydro ally can enter another creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hydro ally makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell’s level (rounded down).

actions.name: Water Pulse
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 2 + the spell’s level bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Pincer (Crab only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + 2 + the spell’s level bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tentacle (Octopus only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4 + 2 + the spell’s level bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC is equal to your spell save DC) if it is Medium or smaller creature and the water ally doesn’t have any other creature grappled.

actions.name: Healing Waters (3/Day)
actions.description: The water ally touches one creature in its space, engulfing them within its body momentarily. The target regains hit points equal to 1d6 + the spell’s level, and the waters extinguish all non-magical flames.

Hit Points: 45 + 10 for each spell level above 3rd

Condition Immunities: exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained, unconscious
Senses: darkvision 50 ft., passive Perception 10

Challenge: 12 (8,400 XP)

Pincer (Crab only). Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + 2 + the spell’s level bludgeoning damage.
Tentacle (Octopus only). Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4 + 2 + the spell’s level bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC is equal to your spell save DC) if it is Medium or smaller creature and the water ally doesn’t have any other creature grappled.
Healing Waters (3/Day). The water ally touches one creature in its space, engulfing them within its body momentarily. The target regains hit points equal to 1d6 + the spell’s level, and the waters extinguish all non-magical flames.
